question: Can a small pre-semantic grammar of operation, attachment relation, repetition degree, and closure be recovered from known graph constructions despite style changes, and are corresponding observables sufficiently present in the frozen v5 physical graph world to justify a later blinded historical test?
theory: Complex glyph meaning may be culturally specific paint applied over a smaller structural grammar. The proposed white-paint axes are operation, relation, degree, and closure. Atlas is treated as a controlled synthetic culture whose intended semantics are known, while Mark only sees graph structure.

predictions.prediction: Attachment locus relative to a stable carrier remains recoverable when modifier shape is held out, and outperforms modifier-shape-only features.
predictions.primaryContrast: near-terminal versus interior attachment with tick, zigzag, and fork modifiers balanced across both classes

predictions.prediction: Repeated equivalent adjuncts behave as an ordered variable rather than unrelated categories.
predictions.primaryContrast: one through five repeated carrier attachments

predictions.prediction: Open-to-closed mutation is recoverable as a topology phase change independent of geometric style and an optional continuing tail.
predictions.primaryContrast: open versus closed cycle with tail present or absent

atlasTargets.Ready: carrier + available continuation through prior constraint

calibration.relationEvaluation: hold one modifier shape out entirely, train on the other two, then recover attachment class
calibration.degreeEvaluation: recover repeated-adjunct count from anonymous degree-3 attachment structure and score Spearman rank plus absolute error
calibration.closureEvaluation: leave-one-style-out recovery with tail presence balanced

physicalScreen.caveat: Critical-graph cycle rank cannot see a pure degree-2 pixel loop if the v5 projector contains no critical center on that loop.

claimBoundary.allowed: The white-paint grammar is recoverable in a known synthetic system and its observables can be screened in frozen physical graphs.
forbidden: Atlas meanings discovered in ancient marks
semantic promotion from physical support alone

nextGateIfCalibrationPasses: Freeze a separate blind witness-selection and scoring protocol before testing whether these axes recur across independent historical systems.
